# Sillage Égypte

Sillage Égypte is a private tour operator that designs bespoke journeys across
Egypt for discerning international travellers. Every journey is fully private —
no shared groups — led by certified Egyptologists and specialists, and built
around the traveller's own interests, pace, and time. The brand sits in the
luxury tier of private travel and serves travellers primarily from Europe,
North America, and Japan.

## Core pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview, signature journeys and guides.
- [Journeys](/tours): All private journeys (the starting frameworks we tailor).
- [Cairo, Two Views](/tours/cairo-two-views): 4-day private journey: three nights in Cairo between the Nile and the Pyramids — Giza, Saqqara and Dahshur, the Grand Egyptian Museum, and a felucca at dusk.
- [Egypt in Brief](/tours/egypt-in-brief): 6-day private journey: Cairo and Luxor seen properly — the pyramids, the museum, and the temples and royal tombs of Thebes.
- [The Grand Tour](/tours/grand-tour): 10-day private journey: Cairo, a night beside the temples of Abu Simbel, Aswan and three unhurried days in Luxor, staying in the great houses of the Nile.
- [The Complete Egypt](/tours/complete-egypt): 13-day private journey: Cairo, Luxor, five nights under sail on a dahabiya, Aswan and Abu Simbel, with the Pyramids held for the end.
- [The Nile & the Red Sea](/tours/nile-red-sea): 13-day private journey: Cairo, the Pyramids and the Nile temples by luxury cruiser, then four unhurried days on the Red Sea.
- [Christmas & New Year on the Nile](/tours/christmas-new-year-nile): 14-day private journey: 21 December 2026 to 3 January 2027 — Christmas under sail on a chartered dahabiya, New Year in Aswan, Abu Simbel at dawn.
- [Beyond the Nile](/tours/beyond-the-nile): 16-day private journey: Cairo, Alexandria, Siwa and the Great Sand Sea, then six nights down the Nile by cruiser to Luxor, by way of Abu Simbel.
- [Destinations](/destinations): [Cairo](/destinations/cairo), [Luxor](/destinations/luxor), [Aswan](/destinations/aswan), [Abu Simbel](/destinations/abu-simbel), [Alexandria](/destinations/alexandria), [Hurghada](/destinations/hurghada), [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh).
- [Experiences](/experiences): Single signature moments to build into any journey — [The Empty Plateau](/experiences/the-empty-plateau), [The Empty Museum](/experiences/the-empty-museum), [The Temple by River](/experiences/the-temple-by-river), [The Salt Lakes](/experiences/the-salt-lakes), [Tea on the Terrace](/experiences/tea-on-the-terrace), [Lunch Under Sail](/experiences/lunch-under-sail).

## What we offer

Sillage Égypte creates fully private, expert-led journeys across Egypt: Nile
sailing on private feluccas, Western Desert and Siwa Oasis expeditions, deep
cultural immersion in Cairo and Luxor, the temples of the far south including
Abu Simbel, and the mountains and reefs of Sinai and the Red Sea. We also offer
standalone signature experiences — dawn at the pyramids before opening, a
balloon over Luxor, a temple after dark, dinner with a working archaeologist —
that can punctuate any itinerary.

What distinguishes us is privacy and expertise. We run no scheduled group
departures. Each journey is led by a named Egyptologist or specialist whose
credentials and languages are published on the site, and every itinerary is
designed from a conversation rather than chosen from a fixed menu.

## Pricing and booking model

There is no online booking engine. Every journey is priced individually to its
design — length, standard of accommodation, and experiences included. A traveller
submits an enquiry (preferred dates, interests, party size), and a journey
designer replies within 24 hours to begin a private, no-obligation proposal.
Sillage Égypte is a luxury-tier operator.

## Brand context

Sillage Égypte operates only in Egypt and guides in English, Arabic, French, and
Japanese.
